name: Kolo Card
summary: Visa card with ultra-low ~0.32% conversion fees. 2% BTC cashback (5% welcome bonus). 1-minute KYC via Sumsub. Auto-converts crypto to local currency.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the Kolo Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Kolo Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
